name: TextToConvert
label: Text to Convert
description: The text value that will be converted to a numeric type.

name: OutputType
label: Output Type
description: Specifies the numeric type to which the text should be converted.

selectOptions.label: Integer
selectOptions.description: Converts the text to an integer value.

selectOptions.label: Double
selectOptions.description: Converts the text to a double-precision floating-point value.

selectOptions.label: Decimal
selectOptions.description: Converts the text to a decimal value.

name: ConvertedValue
label: Converted Value
description: Returns the resulting numeric value after conversion.
